analysis.insight_summary: A hardware type mismatch error occurs during an online test with the configuration software and the connected [product_name] hardware. The issue stems from selecting the wrong device version within the software interface, suggesting that version selection clarity could be improved for better usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates the software will either automatically recognize the connected hardware or provide clearer guidance to ensure selection of the correct device type.
